specification_note: DGP mean shifted by +1 sigma (+5.0). Model paths use true mean. Expected: lower tail over-breaches, upper tail under-breaches, RED. PIT should show right-skewed histogram.
samples_note: Samples are model paths (well-specified Gaussian). PIT = P(model_sample <= misspecified_realisation) — non-uniform PIT reveals the misspecification.
